opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for other tuition‑fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HEI for academic year 2026‑27 (including second‑degree applicants meeting additional criteria).
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition‑fee support of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland for the 2026‑27 academic year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, with a place on an eligible taught or research master’s programme at a Scottish university for the 2026‑27 academic year.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support of up to £5,000 per year to eligible master’s students to assist with postgraduate study costs.
